why: Mac OS 9.2.1's Appearance control panel quits with error 2 when Theme Files holds more than about 75-90 added themes (75 opened, 90 crashed, in two cold boots each; a 4 MB memory partition did not help). The merged collections have 101 distinct theme files, so the base keeps 64 (headroom for themes a user adds) and drops lite/no-icon/older/duplicate variants of a kept theme and a few novelty or seasonal ones. Sound sets are not limited (all 79 install).
